summary: Iteration 26 bug-fix regression: 12/12 backend pytest cases passed covering upload reliability (10 consecutive uploads 200 OK + /api/files retrievable), schoolgram post with image, announcement with image, candidate create ketua/wakil + reject 'anggota' (400), settings school_logo_url update, feedback create+delete+idempotent 404, barcode attendance method accepted, admin_perpus role creation + orang_tua role rejected (400), AI book summary works (not 'Fitur AI belum aktif'), class + student creation prerequisites. Frontend verified via Playwright: Elections position dropdown shows only Ketua/Wakil; MasterAccounts role dropdown contains admin_perpus and NO orang_tua; Jurusan field removed from student form; Chat Wali-Ortu nav item removed and /chats route returns 'No routes matched'; Attendance page titled 'Presensi Barcode' with only manual NISN input + USB barcode scanner (SIAP SCAN auto-enter active, no QR camera/video element); Export Excel button visible for super_admin; Feedback page shows 'Hapus' buttons for reviewer.

issues: Nav item still labeled 'Presensi QR' while the page title is now 'Presensi Barcode'. Update DashboardLayout.jsx sidebar label to 'Presensi Barcode' for consistency.

action_items: (Minor cosmetic) Rename sidebar nav label 'Presensi QR' -> 'Presensi Barcode' in DashboardLayout.jsx to match page title.

(Optional cleanup) DashboardLayout.jsx line 37 still has 'orang_tua: Orang Tua' in the ROLE_LABELS map; harmless (no new orang_tua can be created and route-level users won't exist) but can be removed for cleanliness.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~4100 lines) remains monolithic; splitting into routers is still recommended but non-blocking.
Chat endpoints (/api/chats, /api/chats/{sid}/messages) still exist in backend even though frontend route+nav removed. Consider removing or gating if the feature is truly deprecated.
put_object retry logic (lines 73-100) looks sound; 10x upload test confirms no 500 'Storage tidak tersedia' intermittents.
seed_data_creation: All test data (candidates, feedback, post, announcement, admin_perpus user, test class+siswa, test book) was created and deleted within the same test. No persistent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Settings schema uses 'school_logo_url' (not 'logo_url'). Users POST /api/users requires 'phone' when role=siswa. Classes POST /api/classes accepts {name, subjects}. /api/attendance/scan accepts method in {qr, barcode, manual}. The /chats backend routes still exist though UI route is removed. If the main agent fixes the sidebar label and wants retest, re-run only Attendance.jsx UI check.
rca of the issue: N/A — all previously reported bugs are fixed and verified.
